props.dek: Roma Ransom, the violin and guitar duo of Grace Easley and Gordon Lewis, is now one of our Featured Artists.
props.meta_description: Roma Ransom, a violin and guitar duo from Colorado Springs playing gypsy jazz, Eastern European folk and old-time ballads, joins Signet Artists.
props.llms_description: This post announces that Roma Ransom, the Colorado Springs duo of Grace Easley on violin and vocals and Gordon Lewis on guitar, is now a Featured Artist with Signet Artists. It covers their gypsy jazz, Eastern European folk and old-time repertoire, their festival and film credits, and how to book them for weddings, parties and corporate events in Colorado.

hero.alt: Gordon Lewis and Grace Easley walking through a pasture in cowboy hats, his guitar and her violin in hand.

video.title: Roma Ransom at the Parker Days Festival

props.html:
We have some exciting news if you’ve been looking for a violin and guitar duo in Colorado. Roma Ransom is now one of our Featured Artists, and we’re thrilled to have them on our Artist Roster!

Grace Easley and Gordon Lewis met busking on a street in Springfield, Missouri, and they’ve played together ever since. They’re married now, they live in Colorado Springs, and they play all over the Front Range and the mountains.

props.caption: Roma Ransom on the East Music Stage at the Parker Days Festival in Parker, Colorado.

props.html:
They named the duo for the music of Romania, and their song list goes from gypsy jazz tunes like Caravan and Tchavolo Swing to Romanian and Eastern European folk, old-time ballads like Shady Grove and St. James Infirmary, and their own songs.

Both of them trained classically from an early age, Grace on violin and viola and Gordon on guitar. Grace sings, too, so they can play a whole set of instrumental tunes or mix in the ballads and blues.

For about a decade they’ve played more than 200 shows a year across North America, and they’ve shared festival bills with Leftover Salmon and Larry and His Flask. They’ve played Dazzle in Denver and a VIP event at the Pikes Peak Center for an Itzhak Perlman performance, and Colorado Public Radio featured them on Air Check.

Their music has also been in films and ads for Patagonia, Yeti, Huckberry and Bud Light.

props.text: Booking Roma Ransom for your event

props.html: Violin and guitar make a lovely wedding ceremony, and Roma Ransom is a great fit for a cocktail hour, a dinner party or a banquet when you want music with some character. They bring their own sound system, so outdoor events are easy, too. Want to hear more? Check out Roma Ransom’s video clips.
